title: Enchanted Snow Globe
body:
"A snowglobe unlike any other, providing deeply rich and magical powers!"

Description

The Enchanted Snowglobe is an object that can spawn from the Santa Airdrop during the 2025 Christmas Event.


Interacting with it causes it to spawn a snow globe somewhere in the map and uses the item, deleting it and sending the alert:

Christmas Snowglobe

A very festive snowglobe has been summoned!

Appearance

Enchanted Snowglobe is a small snow globe about 2x2x2 units in size. It has a gold base with a sparkling dome on top, wearing 2 shine effects. A little bit of snow can be seen piled in it, with some floating around.

Trivia

  • The correct term is actually "Snow Globe", it's spelled incorrectly in the game.
